Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s result. After the WebSurfer showed sources stating Charles Mingus was born in Nogales, Arizona, the Planner incorrectly concluded he was “from Los Angeles, California,” shifting the target state to California and the race to the Long Beach event. This conflation of birthplace with being “from” (and contradicting the immediately preceding evidence) set the chain toward the wrong city/state and race, leading the solution down an incorrect path.
